additional_concerns: The formula answers only whether an applicable paragraph 14 request has been made. TRUE does not establish demonstration, SFC satisfaction or substantive compliance; FALSE does not extinguish confirmation or underlying duties.

Footnote 5's unqualified wording permits a rival reading of demonstration's conditionality. Reading it as minimum content governed by paragraph 14's express request condition is supported, but the formula does not resolve that interpretive alternative.
Provider scope and the existence, timing and applicability of a request remain supplied judgments. The excerpts provide no actual request evidence or complete applicability perimeter.

The supplied UT Code 6.8 passages concern register maintenance and requested disclosure of its location; 6.11C concerns valuation supervision. Neither supplies a general tokenisation safe harbour. The separate intermediary paragraph 13 likewise does not determine whether a paragraph 14 request occurred.

The complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and referenced Appendix factors are not supplied. They matter to a broader compliance assessment, without becoming additional conditions for this request-occurrence question.
No unsupported additional permission or restriction appears in the Boolean trigger itself. Structural tool results establish neither legal applicability nor factual satisfaction.
